_about: 0.4.0 (6 Nov 2026), GitHub issue 33: a refused loot says why, in the game's own words: HUD 2's card with Alerts on, else the Neural Net line.

rows.label: Tractor Failure says why
rows.help: The Tractor Failure line adds why the item was refused: cargo hold, nanobots, shield batteries or that ammo full. With HUD 2's Alerts on, the alert card says it whatever this row says.

hud_alerts.help: A short card when something needs you now (shield failing, missile incoming, cruise disrupted, hold full, loot the tractor refused and why), naming the button that helps; that slot lights up.
